home.intro: For over 25 years, Transition Music has been the trusted music infrastructure behind the world's leading media brands — delivering end-to-end licensing, supervision, publishing, and custom composition at scale.

about.storyParagraphOne: Transition Music Corporation was founded with a singular mission: to make world-class music accessible, manageable, and profitable for media companies of every size. Over the past 25 years, we have grown from a boutique licensing firm into one of the most respected full-service music companies in the industry.
about.storyParagraphTwo: Our team is led by Donna Ross Jones, a music industry veteran whose career spans Grammy and Emmy award-winning productions. Under her leadership, TMC has been recognized by the National Music Publishers' Association (NMPA) as a Top 100 Music Publisher for ten consecutive years — a distinction that reflects our commitment to both creative excellence and rigorous rights management.
about.storyParagraphThree: Today, we serve as the outsourced music department for over 29 active television series across 8+ networks, managing everything from initial music strategy through final royalty disbursement. Our clients trust us not just as a vendor, but as a true creative and operational partner.

services.introParagraphOne: Transition Music offers a comprehensive suite of music services designed to meet the needs of today's media landscape. Whether you require a single track cleared or a complete outsourced music infrastructure, we deliver with precision, creativity, and care.
services.introParagraphTwo: Our integrated approach means that every service we offer is connected — licensing informs supervision, supervision informs publishing, and publishing informs royalty collection. The result is a seamless music ecosystem that works harder for your content and your bottom line.
